stewardship-orchestrator.description: Executive Architecture Board for the 200-Series. Delegates S213-S216 investigation to specialist subagents, synthesizes findings, writes deliverables, enforces stop conditions.

stewardship-inspector.description: Audits real (non-synthetic) artifacts against S208 controls: the 6 drift categories, technical debt items, learner-safety impact. Use for S213 category review and S215 debt verification.

registry-integrity.description: Validates single-source-of-truth and searches for duplicate ownership paths across all six registries. Use for S214 and the registry-integrity check in S216.

drift-detector.description: Constructs controlled drift scenarios and scores detection, severity assignment, and response quality against the S208 Drift Detection Model. Use for S213 and drift-prevention checks in S216.

governance-validator.description: Reviews mitigation effectiveness, scalability, sustainability, operational resilience, and stop-condition compliance. Use for S215 mitigation review and S216 recertification scoring.

validate.template: Run the validation pipeline: node scripts/validate.js. Report all errors, warnings, and failures grouped by section and defect type. Prioritize critical and high-severity findings.

audit-section.template: Audit all questions in section $ARGUMENTS using the CAQS v1.0 standard (knowledge/CAQS_v1.0.md). Follow the audit workflow defined in ai/WORKFLOWS.md. Produce a per-question audit report with PASS/WARN/FAIL classifications and a change report for corrections needed.
audit-section.description: Audit a question section against CAQS standards

review-batch.template: Review the audit findings for batch $ARGUMENTS. Cross-reference each finding against knowledge/DEFECT_LIBRARY.md. For every FAIL, determine the exact field correction with before/after values. Output a CHANGE_REPORT.md with all corrections listed.
review-batch.description: Generate change report from audit findings

goal.description: Set a session-scoped goal with auto-continue until complete
